data.desc: Arbe (NASDAQ: ARBE), a global leader in ultra-high-resolution radar solutions, is redefining radar as a core sensing platform for next-generation mobility and advanced sensing applications. Arbe's complete radar technology stack, from proprietary chipsets to radar systems and AI algorithms that produce perception-ready data, delivers the detail and real-time processing that demanding sensing applications require. Arbe enables OEMs, Tier-1s, and defense integrators to build more capable perception systems for passenger vehicles, robotaxis, heavy machinery, counter-drone systems, and unmanned ground vehicles. Headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel , the company also operates offices in the United States , Germany , and China .
